name: Google Gemini
label: Google Gemini
description: Official Gemini API (Google AI Studio / Generative Language v1beta) on the v2 agent model contract (INPUT llm_input → OUTPUT llm_output). operation selects generateContent, Veo predictLongRunning, LRO poll, or embedContent. Thinking models (gemini-2.5 / gemini-3+) auto-get generationConfig.thinkingConfig {includeThoughts:true, thinkingBudget:-1} unless the caller set one, so thought summaries stream on the thinking channel. Auth is StudioQuack secret api_key sent as x-goog-api-key. Image/audio/video/PDF use type file (platform ref-id). Docs: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs. Terms: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms. Never log api_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: llm_input
ports.description: v2 LLM request so this node can sit on the AI Agent model FUNCTION port. Shape: {messages, tools?, contents?, generationConfig?, instances?, operation_name?, file?}. Image/audio/video/PDF use type file (platform ref-id), never inline bytes. Do not put api_key here.

schema.label: messages
schema.description: Conversation for chat / generate_image. Gemini REST field is contents (role user|model). OfficialApiNode does not remap messages→contents; send contents as well when the engine does not. Example: [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}].

schema.label: contents
schema.description: GenerateContentRequest.contents. Prefer this for a faithful REST body.

schema.label: tools
schema.description: Optional functionDeclarations / Google tools. Omit or [] sends no tools. Do not enable googleSearch unless the operator opts in (separate terms).

schema.label: file
schema.description: Platform file ref-id for multimodal parts (image/audio/video/PDF). Never inline bytes.

schema.label: operation_name
schema.description: LRO name from generate_video for download_video (GET /v1beta/{operation_name}).

schema.label: inputFiles
schema.description: user-uploaded files and voice clips for the model

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind: image, document, audio, or video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png

children.label: source
children.description: How the payload is carried: base64 or url.

children.label: data
children.description: base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url)

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name

schema.label: systemInstruction
schema.description: Request-body parameter `systemInstruction` for operation: chat.

schema.label: generationConfig
schema.description: Request-body parameter `generationConfig` for operations: chat, generate_image.

schema.label: safetySettings
schema.description: Request-body parameter `safetySettings` for operations: chat, generate_image.

schema.label: toolConfig
schema.description: Request-body parameter `toolConfig` for operation: chat.

schema.label: cachedContent
schema.description: Request-body parameter `cachedContent` for operation: chat.

schema.label: instances
schema.description: Request-body parameter `instances` for operation: generate_video.

schema.label: parameters
schema.description: Request-body parameter `parameters` for operation: generate_video.

schema.label: prompt
schema.description: Request-body parameter `prompt` for operation: generate_video.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Request-body parameter `content` for operation: embeddings.

schema.label: embedContentConfig
schema.description: Embedding options object for operation embeddings, sent as body field embedContentConfig (replaces the deprecated top-level taskType / title / outputDimensionality). Keys: taskType (RETRIEVAL_QUERY | RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT | SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY | CLASSIFICATION | CLUSTERING | QUESTION_ANSWERING | FACT_VERIFICATION | CODE_RETRIEVAL_QUERY), title (only with RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT), outputDimensionality (integer), autoTruncate (boolean). Example: {"taskType":"RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT","title":"Handbook","outputDimensionality":768}.

ports.name: llm_output
ports.description: v2 LLM response envelope. Success includes status/data from OfficialApiNode. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed Gemini JSON (GenerateContentResponse, Operation, or EmbedContentResponse).

schema.label: result
schema.description: canonical assistant payload {role,content,tool_calls?,output_files?,…}

schema.label: outputFiles
schema.description: files produced by the model, e.g. generated images/audio

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official Gemini verb. EXACT values: chat | generate_image | generate_video | download_video | embeddings. Default chat = POST /v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent.

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: Google AI Studio API key. Sent as header x-goog-api-key. StudioQuack secret binding only. Never logged. Empty → error 'api_key is required'.

configurationParameters.label: Model
configurationParameters.description: Model id in the URL path (models/{model}). Default gemini-3.7-flash (latest stable Flash). Chat: gemini-3.7-flash, gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3-flash-preview; previous gemini-2.5-flash / gemini-2.5-pro / gemini-2.5-flash-lite (shutdown 2026-10-16). Image: gemini-3.1-flash-image (Nano Banana 2), gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image, gemini-3-pro-image, gemini-2.5-flash-image. Video: veo-3.1-generate-preview / veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview. Embeddings: gemini-embedding-2-preview / gemini-embedding-001. Verify live list in AI Studio. Docs: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models .

configurationParameters.label: Generationconfig
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `generationConfig` for operations: chat, generate_image.

configurationParameters.label: Messages
configurationParameters.description: Conversation for chat / generate_image. Gemini REST field is contents (role user|model). OfficialApiNode does not remap messages→contents; send contents as well when the engine does not. Example: [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}].

configurationParameters.label: Contents
configurationParameters.description: GenerateContentRequest.contents. Prefer this for a faithful REST body.

configurationParameters.label: Tools
configurationParameters.description: Optional functionDeclarations / Google tools. Omit or [] sends no tools. Do not enable googleSearch unless the operator opts in (separate terms).

configurationParameters.label: Safetysettings
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `safetySettings` for operations: chat, generate_image.

configurationParameters.label: Operation Name
configurationParameters.description: LRO name from generate_video for download_video (GET /v1beta/{operation_name}).

configurationParameters.label: Embedcontentconfig
configurationParameters.description: Embedding options object for operation embeddings, sent as body field embedContentConfig (replaces the deprecated top-level taskType / title / outputDimensionality). Keys: taskType (RETRIEVAL_QUERY | RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT | SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY | CLASSIFICATION | CLUSTERING | QUESTION_ANSWERING | FACT_VERIFICATION | CODE_RETRIEVAL_QUERY), title (only with RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT), outputDimensionality (integer), autoTruncate (boolean). Example: {"taskType":"RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT","title":"Handbook","outputDimensionality":768}.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: HTTP timeout. Default 300. Floor 1. Video LRO may need 600.

configurationParameters.label: Stream
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: controls whether Google Gemini requests a streamed completion and fans live deltas through helper emitPartial. Canonical flag. When true the node POSTs stream:true, parses SSE data: lines, emitPartial("thinking", delta) for reasoning/thinking and emitPartial("answer", delta) for content; thoughts also appear on llm_output.result.thoughts / thinking; finish_reason, usage and tool_calls are assembled at the end. Accepted: select true | false. Default: true. Invalid/blank → true. Example: true.
